attributes.name: featured/tag label treatment
attributes.definition: How a featured or highlight tag/label is rendered visually.

values.definition: Unfilled text label in an accent colour, no badge background.
Label with a filled or pill/box background.
No such tag, or a different treatment.

attributes.name: feature card media
attributes.definition: Whether feature cards include imagery or rely on text/graphic markers only.

values.definition: Cards contain no photos or illustrations, only text and markers.
Cards include a photo or illustration.

attributes.name: feature card index marker
attributes.definition: Whether feature cards carry a numbered marker.

values.definition: Cards are marked with a number in a badge.
Cards are marked with an icon.

attributes.name: card link style
attributes.definition: Treatment of the call-to-action link on a card.

values.definition: Plain text link ending with an arrow glyph.
